gt_flags.translation: Will you connect with me on Instagram?
gt_flags.excerpt: Instagram पे कनेक्ट होगे मेरे साथ?

model_flags.translation: Connected on Instagram with me, yes I will agree but I don't know you yet
model_flags.excerpt: इंस्टाग्राम पर कनेक्ट हो गए मेरे साथ हाँ हो जाऊँगी बट मैं आपको जानती नहीं हूँ ना अभी तो
model_flags.model_context: The user is agreeing to connect on Instagram but states they do not know the expert yet. The expert seems to be accepting the connection.
